export function normalizeExamMarkup(raw) {
	if (!raw) return raw;
	const parts = raw.split(/(\$\$[\s\S]*?\$\$|\\( [^ \)]*\$)/g);
	return parts.map((part, index) => {
		if (index % 2 === 1) return part;
		let text = part;
		text = text.replace(/([A-Za-z0-9]+)_\{([A-Za-z]+)\}/g, function(_m, token, word) {
			return "( " + token + "_{\\mathrm{" + word + "}} )";
		});
		text = text.replace(/([A-Za-z0-9]+)_\{(\d+)\}/g, function(_m, token, base) {
			return "( " + token + "_{" + base + "} )";
		});
		text = text.replace(/([A-Za-z0-9]+)_([A-Za-z]+)\b/g, function(_m, token, word) {
			return "( " + token + "_{\\mathrm{" + word + "}} )";
		});
		return text;
	}).join("");
}
export function Markdown({ children, className }) {
	const source = normalizeExamMarkup(children ?? "");
	const wrapClass = className ? styles.md + " " + className : styles.md;
	return /* @__PURE__ */ _jsxDEV("div", {
		className: wrapClass,
		children: /* @__PURE__ */ _jsxDEV(ReactMarkdown, {
			remarkPlugins: [remarkGfm, remarkMath],
			rehypePlugins: [rehypeKatex],
			children: source
		}, void 0, false, {
			fileName: _jsxFileName,
			lineNumber: 48,
			columnNumber: 7
		}, this)
	}, void 0, false, {
		fileName: _jsxFileName,
		lineNumber: 47,
		columnNumber: 5
	}, this);
}
